mapper.sql: select t.id, t.ticket_no, t.ticket_category, t.priority, t.status, t.summary, t.description, t.source, t.assigned_group, t.assigned_user_id, t.dead_line, t.resolved_time, t.closed_time, t.user_id, t.conversation_id, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.tenant_id from ticket t
mapper.select: where t.user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 order by t.create_time desc
select count(*) from ticket where status = #{status} and deleted = 0
